desc: Implement a helper function or sliding window mechanism to compute the cost (sum of absolute differences from median) for every subarray of length x starting at each index from 0 to n-x.
Use two heaps (max-heap for lower half, min-heap for upper half) to maintain the median and track the sum of absolute differences as the window slides, updating the cost array in O(n log x) time.
Set up a DP table of size (k+1) x n, initializing dp[0][i] = 0 for all i, and other entries to infinity.

Iterate through each possible end index i from 0 to n-1, and for each count j from 1 to k, update dp[j][i] by considering both skipping the current element and forming a subarray ending at i (if i >= x-1).
Return the value dp[k][n-1] as the final answer.
